mkdir -p /tmp/redact && cat > /tmp/redact/r.py <<'E'
import json,re,sys,os,tempfile
p=sys.argv[1]
R=[
(r"My monthly take-home income is \$4,800\. ",""),
(r", and \$350 on debt repayments",""),
(r"\| Take-home income \| \$4,800 \|\n",""),
(r"\| Debt repayments \| \$350 \|\n",""),
(r"\| \*\*Total expenses\*\* \| \*\*\$2,850\*\* \|\n",""),
(r"- \*\*Monthly surplus:\*\*[^\n]*\n",""),
(r"- \*\*Savings after 4 months:\*\*[^\n]*\n",""),
(r"- \*\*Balance after 4 months:\*\*[^\n]*\n",""),
(r"- \*\*Expenses:\*\*[^\n]*\n",""),
(r"- \*\*Surplus:\*\*[^\n]*\n",""),
(r"Your monthly surplus is \$1,950, and I wrote","I wrote"),
(r"Expenses: .*? Months to save 6,000: 6,000 / 1,950 ≈ 3\.08, so 4 months","Months to save 6,000: 4 months"),
(r"\$6,000 / \$1,950 ≈ 3\.08, so \*\*4 months\*\* \(3 full months[^)]*\)","**4 months**"),
(r"\$6,000 ÷ \$1,950 ≈ 3\.08, so it takes 4 months\. After 3 months[^\n]*?short\.","it takes 4 months."),
]
RES=re.compile(r"4,?800|[Dd]ebt|\b350\b|1,?950|2,?850|20,?200|5,?850|[Ii]ncome|take-home|[Ss]urplus")
KEYS={"command","content","stdout","output","description","text","lastPrompt"}
n=0
def fix(o,key=None):
    global n
    if isinstance(o,str):
        s=o
        for a,b in R: s=re.sub(a,b,s,flags=re.S if a.startswith("Expenses") else 0)
        if s!=o: n+=1
        return s
    if isinstance(o,list): return [fix(x,key) for x in o]
    if isinstance(o,dict): return {k:fix(v,k) for k,v in o.items()}
    return o
out=[]
for l in open(p,encoding="utf-8"):
    d=fix(json.loads(l))
    out.append(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")))
fd,t=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(p)); 
with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write("\n".join(out)+"\n")
os.chmod(t,0o600); os.replace(t,p)
print("strings changed:",n)
for i,l in enumerate(out):
    if RES.search(l): print("residual line",i,json.loads(l).get("type"))
E
